scenarios.definition: QLB-EXT-001's stimulus with quote_requested_one emitted twice (4 requests: one, one, three, zero); ordering and payload shape otherwise valid, so the only breach is cardinality
scenarios.derivation: C-VALID.occurrence_bounds.quote_requested_one.max = 1; the stimulus emits it twice. C-VALID.expected_path yields two predecessor-ordering constraints (three.after_any, zero.after_any); both still hold against one,one,three,zero, so no ordering finding is derivable. No required property is absent or mistyped.
scenarios.evidence_required: product-out/run-result.json runStatus rule_violation_detected; report.json result.findings containing exactly one finding of type duplicate_event naming quote_requested_one; record state completed and response_status supported; all four binding gates and offline verification passing before any semantic read

scenarios.definition: QLB-EXT-001's stimulus with the properties object retained on quote_requested_three and only the numberOfItems key removed; the complete three-event sequence is preserved
scenarios.derivation: C-VALID.required_properties.quote_requested_three.numberOfItems = 'number'. The carrier event is present and in position, so no missing_required_event is derivable; its properties object no longer carries the required key, which is exactly missing_required_property. Wave 1's retained capture bytes establish that the collector sources canonical event properties from the request body's properties object, so removing that key is what the contract's property constraint actually sees. Derived from C-VALID alone; Qualiber's own carrier-absent reference fixture is disqualified as a Lab oracle and was not consulted.
scenarios.evidence_required: product-out/run-result.json runStatus rule_violation_detected; report.json result.findings containing exactly one finding of type missing_required_property naming quote_requested_three; record state completed and response_status supported; binding gates and offline verification passing before any semantic read

scenarios.definition: QLB-EXT-001's stimulus with properties.numberOfItems set to the string "3" on quote_requested_three; all other structure preserved
scenarios.derivation: C-VALID.required_properties.quote_requested_three.numberOfItems declares type 'number' and the observed value is a string, which is property_type_mismatch. The key is present, so missing_required_property is not derivable. C-VALID.property_consistency is empty, so no consistency finding is derivable from the untouched decorative top-level field. Only the properties carrier is mutated, because Wave 1's retained capture bytes show that is the field the contract constraint reaches.
scenarios.evidence_required: product-out/run-result.json runStatus rule_violation_detected; report.json result.findings containing exactly one finding of type property_type_mismatch naming quote_requested_three; record state completed and response_status supported; binding gates and offline verification passing before any semantic read
